fold_local_preprocessing.feature_budget_rule: Within each training fold, retain eligible features and, only if their count exceeds the frozen primary budget, rank by training-fold pre-standardization variance descending with original feature index as deterministic tie-breaker.
fold_local_preprocessing.imputation: none; missing values remain NaN for native MOFA Gaussian handling

full_data_simulation_truth_evaluation.private_subspace_recovery: Evaluate view-specific signal capture using fitted factor scores/loadings and the frozen truth-metric definitions; preserve descriptive status where MOFA has no explicit private latent block.
full_data_simulation_truth_evaluation.role: truth recovery only; never substituted for held-out reconstruction

heldout_metrics.cross_view_retrieval: Same true row_source pairing and random-adjusted MRR definitions used in 05c1, using one-view posterior projections.
heldout_metrics.heldout_reconstruction: Same normalized reconstruction-error definition used in 05c1, evaluated against complete known simulation truth.
heldout_metrics.latent_effective_rank: Effective rank of held-out all-view posterior factor scores.
heldout_metrics.missing_view_reconstruction: Same omitted-view R2 and clipped reconstruction-score definitions used in 05c1.
heldout_metrics.modality_balance: Normalized entropy of per-view MOFA loading energy for each factor.

out_of_sample_projection.all_view_projection: Use RNA, methylation, and CNV observed entries to infer z_hat.
out_of_sample_projection.frozen_parameter_estimates: Use fitted posterior means of MOFA weights W and expected Gaussian noise precisions tau from the training fit. No held-out sample may update W, tau, sparsity parameters, ARD parameters, or preprocessing statistics.
out_of_sample_projection.missing_values: For each held-out sample and view, only finite observed features contribute to A and b.
out_of_sample_projection.missing_view_projection: Exclude the omitted view from A and b, infer z_hat from the remaining view or views, then reconstruct the omitted standardized view as z_hat @ W_omitted^T.
out_of_sample_projection.name: fixed-parameter Gaussian posterior mean projection
out_of_sample_projection.reconstruction: x_hat_m = z_hat @ W_m^T in the fold-local standardized coordinate system
out_of_sample_projection.single_view_projection_for_retrieval: Infer z_hat independently from one view at a time using the same frozen W/tau. Because all projections share the fitted factor coordinate system, no test-set alignment or refitting is allowed.

paired_comparison_with_05c1.reason: Use identical held-out samples for paired linear-versus-MOFA comparisons.

prohibited_operations: Using the disclosed sable_mo_v1 pilot for confirmatory MOFA results.
Changing MOFA ranks after viewing results.
Using held-out samples to rank, impute, center, or scale features.
Replacing native MOFA missingness with global imputation.
Computing held-out factors as raw X @ W.
Refitting or variationally updating the MOFA model on held-out samples.
Using survival, metastasis, clinical labels, or biological program labels.
purpose: Freeze a leakage-safe out-of-sample projection rule for Gaussian MOFA+ before the first MOFA architecture-screening fit.
reason_for_separate_protocol: The frozen Paper 5 benchmark requires held-out reconstruction, same-patient cross-view retrieval, and missing-view reconstruction. A raw matrix multiplication of held-out data by fitted MOFA weights is not assumed to reproduce posterior factor expectations. The benchmark therefore freezes a model-based Gaussian posterior projection rule before any MOFA result is generated.

seed_policy.seed_rule: SHA256-derived deterministic seed from master seed, fit stage, scenario ID, replicate index, simulation seed, latent rank, and fold index where applicable.
